svg.title: The crew
svg.desc: The crew, ten optional specialist sub-agents: creative director: Pitches three concepts and a wildcard, then signs off the storyboard.; brand designer: Pulls a brand kit from your repo or site, or proposes one.; scriptwriter: Writes every word you hear or read, each fact tied to a source.; storyboard artist: Turns the picked concept into shots, timings and an animatic.; motion designer: Builds one scene in its own sandbox; several work in parallel.; sound designer: Music bed, effects on cues, the sound logo and a metered mix.; voice director: Casting, pronunciation, the voice-over and other languages.; editor: Cuts real footage by transcript; captions and reframes it.; researcher: Checks every claim against its source and every asset's license.; critic: Watches the draft like a stranger: blocker, should-fix, polish.
